heterogeneous catalysts are in different physical state from the reactants AND homogeneous catalysts are in the same physical state as the reactants
manufacture of ammonia in the Haber process – heterogeneous AND removal of nitrogen oxides from car exhausts – heterogeneous
oxidation of sulfur dioxide in the atmosphere – homogeneous
